source.symbol: Accepted version-bump tag revision, Hg source and bump-file selectors

text:
types: ["release"]
                  revision: "{head_rev}"

                  # Used to map hg revisions to the git revisions needed by scriptworker-lando
                  hg-repo-url:
                      by-project:
                          comm-beta: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-beta
                          comm-release: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-release
                          comm-esr153: https://hg.mozilla.org/releases/comm-esr153
                          try-comm-central: https://hg.mozilla.org/try-comm-central
                          default: ""
            - version-bump:
                  bump-files:
                      by-release-type:
                          default: ["mail/config/version_display.txt"]
                          release|esr.*:
                              - "mail/config/version.txt"
                              - "mail/config/version_display.txt"

tasks:
    thunderbird:
        name: thunderbird-version-bump
title: Accepted version-bump tag revision, Hg source and bump-file selectors
